newsitem.title: USA: Senate panel tax bill eases disaster muni loans.
newsitem.headline: Senate panel tax bill eases disaster muni loans.

text.p: The Senate Finance Committee late Thursday approved an amendment to tax-cut legislation that would make it easier for disaster victims to get low-interest loans backed by mortgage revenue bonds, a Senate aide said.

The aide to Sen. Kent Conrad, a Democrat from North Dakota who pushed for the amendment, said it would waive a first-time homebuyer requirement and current limits on income and purchase price for loans in presidentially declared disaster areas.
A tax package approved by the House Ways and Means Committee last week includes a similar proposal.
